"""Contract tests for the eMicro control plane (development scratch)."""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/emicro-deps')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('drv', '/workspace/project/driver.py')
drv = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(drv)

FAILS = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAILS.append('%s:\n    got  %r\n    want %r' % (name, got, want))

def run(req):
    if isinstance(req, (dict, list)):
        req = json.dumps(req).encode()
    return drv.solve(req)

LIM = {'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
def job(events, services=None, limits=None):
    if services is None:
        services = [{'name':'A','label':10},{'name':'B','label':4}]
    return {'services':services,'limits':limits or LIM,'events':events}

def evs(jobobj):
    r = run({'jobs':[jobobj]})
    return r['results'][0].get('events')

def last(events, services=None, limits=None):
    out = evs(job(events, services, limits))
    return out[-1] if out else None

E = [{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A,B) allow;'},{'op':'commit','epoch':1}]
IMG = {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,False,True],'rows':[[4294967295,1],[2,4294967295],[4294967295,4294967295]]}}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- envelope
check('empty jobs', run(b'{"jobs":[]}'), {'results':[]})
check('bad top', run(b'{"jobs":{},"x":1}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('dup key', run(b'{"jobs":[],"jobs":[]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('dup nested', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[]}]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('nan', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[],"x":NaN}]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('inf float', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[],"x":1e400}]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('bom', run(b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"jobs":[]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('trailing json', run(b'{"jobs":[]} {}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('trailing ws', run(b'{"jobs":[]}  \n\t'), {'results':[]})
check('bad utf8', run(b'{"jobs":[\xff]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('big int', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[],"x":' + b'1'*5000 + b'}]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
check('float field', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[],"x":1.5}]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
nested='0'
for _ in range(62): nested='['+nested+']'
check('depth 64 job', run(('{"jobs":['+nested+']}').encode()), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('depth 65 req', run(('{"jobs":[['+nested+']]}').encode()), {'error':'invalid'})
check('5 jobs', run({'jobs':[job([])]*5}), {'error':'invalid'})
check('empty services', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('bad limits', run({'jobs':[job([], limits={'images':1})]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('limit zero', run({'jobs':[job([], limits=dict(LIM, units=0))]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('limit over', run({'jobs':[job([], limits=dict(LIM, units=1025))]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('dup label', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'A','label':1},{'name':'B','label':1}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('dup name', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'A','label':1},{'name':'A','label':2}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('label 0', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'A','label':0}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('label max', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'A','label':4294967295}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('label 4294967294', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'A','label':4294967294}])]}),
      {'results':[{'events':[{'ok':True,'active':None,'images':[],'units':0,'contexts':0,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}]}]})
check('17 services', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'S%d'%i,'label':i+1} for i in range(17)])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('bad name', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'1A','label':1}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('long name', run({'jobs':[job([], services=[{'name':'A'*25,'label':1}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('unknown op', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'nope'}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('extra field', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'inspect','x':1}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('missing field', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'commit'}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('bool not int', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'commit','epoch':True}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('surrogate policy', run(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":'+json.dumps(LIM).encode()+b',"events":[{"op":"stage","epoch":1,"policy":"\\ud800"}]}]}'), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('unit ns 0 ok', last([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'}]), {'ok':True})
check('unit ns max ok', last([{'op':'spawn','unit':[4294967295,1,1],'service':'A'}]), {'ok':True})
check('unit pid 0', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,0,1],'service':'A'}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('unit gen 0', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,0],'service':'A'}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('wire len 97', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'recv','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':'a'*97}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('wire len 96 ok', last([{'op':'recv','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':'a'*96}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('wire bad hex', last([{'op':'recv','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':'z'*48}]), {'error':'rejected'})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- policy
def stage(policy, services=None):
    return last([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':policy}], services)
check('empty language', stage(''), {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False],'rows':[[4294967295,4294967295]]}})
check('all allow', stage('match() allow;'), {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[True],'rows':[[0,0]]}})
check('drop only', stage('match(A) drop;'), {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False],'rows':[[4294967295,4294967295]]}})
check('syntax error', stage('match(A) allow'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('unregistered', stage('match(C) allow;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('vertical tab', stage('match(A) allow;\v'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('bad action', stage('match(A) permit;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('depth 17', stage('not('*16 + 'match(A)' + ')'*16 + ' allow;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('depth 16', stage('not('*15 + 'match(A)' + ')'*15 + ' allow;')['ok'], True)
check('path 17', stage('match(' + ','.join(['A']*17) + ') allow;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('path 16', stage('match(' + ','.join(['A']*16) + ') allow;')['ok'], True)
check('nonmatch path 5', stage('startswith(A,A,A,A,A) allow;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('9 complex rules', stage(''.join('not(match(A)) drop;' for _ in range(9))), {'error':'rejected'})
check('8 complex rules', stage(''.join('not(match(A)) drop;' for _ in range(8)))['ok'], True)
check('33 atoms in complex', stage('(' + ' and '.join(['match(A)']*33) + ') allow;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('32 atoms in complex', stage('(' + ' and '.join(['match(A)']*32) + ') allow;')['ok'], True)
check('5 distinct nonmatch', stage('startswith(A) allow; endswith(B) allow; contains(A) allow; startswith(B) allow; endswith(A) allow;'), {'error':'rejected'})
check('4 distinct nonmatch', stage('startswith(A) allow; endswith(B) allow; contains(A) allow; startswith(B) allow;')['ok'], True)
check('bfs labels', stage('match(A) allow; match(B) allow;')['image'], {'accept':[False,True,True],'rows':[[1,2],[1,2],[1,2]]})
check('two rules one line', stage('match(A) allow; match(B) drop;')['ok'], True)
check('newline separated', stage('match(A) allow;\nmatch(B) drop;')['ok'], True)
check('tabs and ff', stage('match(A)\tallow;\x0c')['ok'], True)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- replay
check('stage same epoch', last(E+[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('stage lower epoch', last(E+[{'op':'stage','epoch':0,'policy':'match(A) allow;'}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('stage epoch 0 invalid', run({'jobs':[job([{'op':'stage','epoch':0,'policy':'match(A) allow;'}])]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('stage ok', evs(job(E))[0], IMG)
check('commit unknown', last([{'op':'commit','epoch':7}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('retire active', last(E+[{'op':'retire','epoch':1}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('retire referenced', last(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},{'op':'retire','epoch':1}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('retire unreferenced', evs(job(E+[{'op':'retire','epoch':1},{'op':'inspect'}]))[2],
      {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,2]],'units':0,'contexts':0,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0})
check('spawn twice same pair', last([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,2],'service':'A'}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('spawn gen reuse', last([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'exit','unit':[0,1,1]},{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('spawn gen bump', last([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'exit','unit':[0,1,1]},{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,2],'service':'A'}]), {'ok':True})
check('spawn unknown service', last([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'C'}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('exit unknown', last([{'op':'exit','unit':[0,1,1]}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('exit wrong gen', last([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'exit','unit':[0,1,2]}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('clone copies contexts', evs(job(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},
      {'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,2,1]},{'op':'inspect'}]))[4],
      {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,2]],'units':2,'contexts':2,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0})
check('clone inherits mark', last(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':5},
      {'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,2,1]},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':5}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('clone inherits service', last(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,2,1]},
      {'op':'begin','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1}]), {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1})
check('clone unknown parent', last([{'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,2,1]}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('clone same pair', last([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,1,2]}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('begin no active', last([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('begin rid repeat', last(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('begin rid higher ok', last(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':2}]), {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1})
check('finish unknown rid', last(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('finish twice', last(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},{'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},{'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('denied context', evs(job([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'},{'op':'commit','epoch':1},{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'B'},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},{'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1}]))[3],
      {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':4294967295})
check('open twice same id', last([{'op':'open','connection':[1,1]},{'op':'open','connection':[1,2]}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('open gen reuse', last([{'op':'open','connection':[1,1]},{'op':'close','connection':[1,1]},{'op':'open','connection':[1,1]}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('open gen bump', last([{'op':'open','connection':[1,1]},{'op':'close','connection':[1,1]},{'op':'open','connection':[1,2]}]), {'ok':True})
check('close unknown', last([{'op':'close','connection':[1,1]}]), {'error':'rejected'})
BASE = E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,2,1],'service':'B'},
          {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},{'op':'open','connection':[1,1]},
          {'op':'send','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'destination':'B'}]
out = evs(job(BASE+[{'op':'recv','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':None}]))
check('recv ok', out[7], {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2})
WIRE = out[6]['wire']
check('wire value', WIRE, '454d43340000000100000001000000040000000100000001')
check('recv wrong wire', last(BASE+[{'op':'recv','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':'00'*24}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('recv upper wire', last(BASE+[{'op':'recv','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':WIRE.upper()}]), {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2})
check('recv wrong service', last(BASE+[{'op':'recv','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':None}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('recv duplicate ok', last(BASE+[{'op':'recv','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':None},
      {'op':'recv','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':None}]), {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2})
check('recv duplicate other rid', last(BASE+[{'op':'recv','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':None},
      {'op':'recv','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':2,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':None}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('recv duplicate after finish', last(BASE+[{'op':'recv','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':None},
      {'op':'finish','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1},{'op':'recv','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':None}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('recv no packet', last(BASE[:-1]+[{'op':'recv','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':None}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('send stream repeat', last(BASE+[{'op':'send','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'destination':'B'}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('send unknown dest', last(BASE[:-1]+[{'op':'send','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'destination':'C'}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('send wrong conn gen', last(BASE[:-1]+[{'op':'send','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,2],'stream':1,'destination':'B'}]), {'error':'rejected'})
FBASE = E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,2,1],'service':'B'},
           {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1}]
check('store ok', last(FBASE+[{'op':'store','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'file':[1,1]}]), {'ok':True})
check('load ok', last(FBASE+[{'op':'store','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'file':[1,1]},
      {'op':'load','file':[1,1],'unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1}]), {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1})
check('store gen reuse', last(FBASE+[{'op':'store','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'file':[1,1]},
      {'op':'unlink','file':[1,1]},{'op':'store','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'file':[1,1]}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('store overwrite same gen', last(FBASE+[{'op':'store','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'file':[1,1]},
      {'op':'store','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'file':[1,1]}]), {'ok':True})
check('store overwrite other gen', last(FBASE+[{'op':'store','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'file':[1,1]},
      {'op':'store','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'file':[1,2]}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('load missing file', last(FBASE+[{'op':'load','file':[1,1],'unit':[0,2,1],'rid':1}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('unlink missing', last([{'op':'unlink','file':[1,1]}]), {'error':'rejected'})
check('store no context', last(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'store','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'file':[1,1]}]), {'error':'rejected'})
# capacity
check('contexts capacity', last(E+[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},
      {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':2}], limits=dict(LIM, contexts=1)), {'error':'rejected'})
check('units capacity', last([{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,2,1],'service':'A'}], limits=dict(LIM, units=1)), {'error':'rejected'})
check('files capacity', last(FBASE+[{'op':'store','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'file':[1,1]},
      {'op':'store','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'file':[2,1]}], limits=dict(LIM, files=1)), {'error':'rejected'})
check('images capacity', last([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'},{'op':'stage','epoch':2,'policy':'match(B) allow;'}], limits=dict(LIM, images=1)), {'error':'rejected'})
check('cells capacity', last([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'},{'op':'stage','epoch':2,'policy':'match(B) allow;'}], limits=dict(LIM, cells=1)), {'error':'rejected'})

print('FAILURES: %d' % len(FAILS))
for f in FAILS: print('  ', f)
